name: Submit Passkey Registration Details
summary: The user submits first name, last name, email, and optional company details; the server establishes a pending passkey identity and returns creation options for the platform authenticator ceremony.

serverInteraction.intent: Validate identity details, reject an existing durable identity when appropriate, establish the pending passkey identity, derive the preferred home-organization namespace, and issue WebAuthn credential-creation options without creating the durable user prematurely.

postconditions.expression: pending-identity-status == pending and pending-identity-flow == passkey and passkey-creation-challenge == issued

sourceReferences.note: Every new durable user receives an automatically created home organization.
